changelog:
Initial release of AI大模型专家｜短剧服装造型设定 – an AI-powered workflow for drama and comic costume styling.

- Provides end-to-end tools to turn short drama, comic, and brand requirements into reusable visual assets and videos.
- Supports role/scene boards, prompt/asset management, and dynamic video generation with consistency controls.
- Integrated with AI-HIVE for streamlined model routing, cost/track management, and multi-channel adaptation.
- Tailored for short drama studios, brand marketers, e-commerce, and international teams needing scalable content production.
- Built-in scripts and workflows cover project blueprints, image generation, video rendering, and asset tracking.
- Includes best-practices on copyright, safety, brand integrity, and platform compliance.
